To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a model for absorption of vapor into a LiBr solution flowing over horizontal tubes is developed and the model results agree with experimental data for smooth tubes when the mass diffusivity is 10 −10  s −1.

a model for absorption of H2O in LiBr solution flowing over horizontal smooth tube is developed, the performance of a horizontal tube bundle absorber is predicted, the calculated performance is compared with experimental results, a parametric study varying diffusivity is conducted and the effects of absorber heat capacity, heat transfer coefficients of the solution and droplets ejected from system on the performance of the absorber are investigated.
the absorption performance of an absorber is affected by the mass diffusivity and the heat transfer coefficient of the ejected droplets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the absorption of water vapor by a falling film of lithium bromide flowing over horizontal tubes in an absorber.
the experimental investigation of the heat and mass transfer performance of an absorption heat exchanger for air conditioning.
the absorption of water vapor in a LiBr/H 2 O absorption system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model is capable of predicting the performance of a horizontal tube bundle absorber.
a mass diffusivity of 1.5 × 10 -11 m 2 s -1 is recommended for use in the model for smooth tube absorption.
